description: This file defines the 'Returns' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. It manages customer return-related data, including adding a return, retrieving a specific return, and listing returns and histories. The class extends a base system engine model and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to product returns.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Represents the returns model handling customer product return data.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Inserts a new return record into the database with the provided data and returns the newly created return ID.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific return by its ID, including status and reasons.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of returns for the current customer, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns made by the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific return, including comments and status changes.
